title: kernel locked up for a few hours
body: Today I stepped away from my PC and when I came back it was unresponsive. I could not open any apps in my KDE desktop environment, it would not let me switch TTY and in the terminal I had open `sudo` locked up the process. I eventually had to forcefuly reboot by long pressing the power button. After rebooting I found this suspicious log in my journalctl.
